displayContent.text:
# Feature Impact Review - organizer-fee-paid-checkbox-20261005

Decision: GO_WITH_CONDITIONS

## Decision

GO_WITH_CONDITIONS. The change is confined to one organizer table and one new
organizer endpoint, and it never moves money by itself: the worst case is a refund
*request* that still has to be settled by an admin through the pre-existing
`confirm-refund` route. The condition is that refund settlement and its audit trail
stay exactly as they are.

## Source of truth

- Refund policy: `calculateTournamentRefundQuote`
  (`src/modules/tournaments/utils/tournament-refund-policy.ts:40`). Amounts are never
  taken from the client or hand-computed.
- Refund request: `TournamentPaymentRepository.createPendingRefund`
  (`tournament-payment.repository.ts:199`), which compare-and-sets
  `payments.refund_status` NULL to `PENDING_REFUND` and refuses a second request.
- Refund settlement: `PaymentsRepository.confirmLegacyRefund`
  (`payments.repository.ts:702`), reachable only through
  `POST /payments/admin/payments/:id/confirm-refund`, `@Roles(ADMIN)`.
- Fee state: `tournament_participants.is_paid`. "Paid through the system" means a
  `payments` row exists with `status = 'COMPLETED'` and `purpose = 'REGISTRATION_FEE'`,
  which is exactly what `findCompletedParticipantPaymentInTx` looks up.
- Authorization: `TournamentAccessService.isManager`, the same check every other
  participant mutation uses.

## Affected

| Area | Change |
|---|---|
| Backend, `tournaments.controller.ts` | new `PATCH :id/participants/:participantId/fee-payment` |
| Backend, `tournament-participant-admin.service.ts` | new `setParticipantFeePaid`, audit + broadcast |
| Backend, `tournament-payment.repository.ts` | `setParticipantPaidInTx` (the transactional flag write) |
| Backend, new DTO | `UpdateParticipantFeePaymentDto { paid }` |
| Backend, two spec files | constructor arity only |
| Web, `RegistrationTab.tsx` | payment badge replaced by a checkbox plus a confirmation |
| Web, `features/tournaments/api.ts` | `setParticipantFeePaid` client |
| Web, `messages/vi.json`, `messages/en.json` | 11 keys each |
| Schema | none |
| Payments module | none |

## Negative cases

| Case | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Caller does not manage the tournament | 403, no transaction opened |
| Participant belongs to another tournament | 404 |
| Flag already equals the requested value | no-op: no transaction, no audit row, no broadcast |
| Tick with no payment row | sets the flag only, creates no `payments` row |
| Untick with no payment row | clears the flag, no refund row, no money movement |
| Untick with a COMPLETED payment and `refund_status` NULL | policy quote, one `PENDING_REFUND` request, audit on both rows |
| Untick twice across a tick in between | second call skips the request instead of hitting the compare-and-set, so the flag is not rolled back |
| Payment already refunded or refund pending | flag still clears, `refundRequested` reports `false` |
| Concurrent unticks | the compare-and-set inside `createPendingRefund` keeps exactly one request; the loser throws inside the transaction, so nothing partially applies |
| Client double-click | the row's checkbox is disabled while its mutation is in flight |

## Security

- The endpoint can only ever *request* a refund. Moving money still requires the
  admin-only settlement route and a proof URL.
- Ownership re-checked server-side; the client never decides eligibility.
- The refund amount is computed server-side by the shared policy. There is no code
  path where a client-supplied number reaches `payment_refunds.amount`.
- Every write is audited inside the same transaction via `AuditService.logUpdate`.
- A repeat refund for the same payment is impossible at both the
  `refund_status` compare-and-set and the unique
  `financial_ledger_entries.idempotency_key`.

## Conditions

1. Do not relax the admin-only settlement route.
2. Re-run `validate-workflow.ps1 -Strict` after the two other in-progress worktrees
   in this workspace are committed, since they are unrelated.

## Evidence

- `npx jest src/modules/tournaments/services/tournament-participant-admin.service.spec.ts`
  → 13 passed. Includes 403, cross-tournament 404, idempotent no-op, mark-paid
  creates no payment row, refund requested through the policy quote, manual mark
  skipped, and a repeat-untick case that asserts no second refund is raised.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` on the backend: the error set is unchanged from `HEAD` for the
  three pre-existing spec files. A fourth spec,
  `tournament-import-legacy-contract.spec.ts`, errors only because of unrelated
  in-progress edits to `tournament-registration.repository.ts` in the same working
  tree.
- Browser, 1568x833, real `RegistrationTab` with a stubbed mutation: three
  participants render correct checkbox states; unticking a manual mark opens the
  neutral confirmation; unticking a system payment opens the danger confirmation
  with a red action; ticking applies immediately with no dialog.

# Implementation Log - organizer-fee-paid-checkbox-20261005

## 2026-10-05

### Backend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `dto/update-participant-fee-payment.dto.ts` | new `UpdateParticipantFeePaymentDto { paid }` |
| `tournaments.controller.ts` | `PATCH :id/participants/:participantId/fee-payment`, guard stack copied from the sibling participant route |
| `tournaments.service.ts` | delegation plus the sibling `broadcastRegistrationChanged` |
| `services/tournament-participant-admin.service.ts` | `setParticipantFeePaid`, plus `AuditService`, `PG_CONNECTION` and `TournamentPaymentRepository` injected |
| `repositories/tournament-payment.repository.ts` | `setParticipantPaidInTx(tx, participantId, isPaid)` |
| `services/tournament-participant-admin.service.spec.ts` | nine cases, constructor updated |
| `tournaments-lite-pairing.spec.ts`, `utils/registration-lifecycle.spec.ts` | constructor arity only |

### Web

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `features/tournaments/api.ts` | `setParticipantFeePaid` |
| `messages/vi.json`, `messages/en.json` | 11 keys each |
| `manage/components/RegistrationTab.tsx` | payment badge replaced by a checkbox; `hasSystemPayment`; `handleFeePaidChange`; a `ConfirmModal` that switches wording and variant on whether a system payment exists |

### Deviations from the plan

- `registeredAt` is `participant.registeredAt`, not `payment.createdAt`. The shared
  projection does not carry `createdAt`, every other caller passes the participant's
  value, and with a `KICKED` trigger the fee is waived so the timestamp cannot change
  the amount.
- `setParticipantPaidInTx` instead of the existing `markParticipantPaid`, because this
  endpoint needs both directions inside a caller-owned transaction.

### Defects found during review, and fixed

1. **Repeat untick would have thrown.** After a refund is raised, a
   tick / untick / tick / untick cycle reached the compare-and-set inside
   `createPendingRefund`, which throws and rolls the whole transaction back, leaving the
   checkbox stuck on. A payment that already carries a refund state now skips the
   request and the flag still clears.
2. **`refundRequested` was wrong.** It reported `completedPayment !== null`, so a
   skipped second refund would still have told the organizer a refund was raised. It
   now reports what the call actually did.
3. **Other rows looked enabled but were inert.** `handleFeePaidChange` guarded on
   `if (feePaymentBusyId) return;` while only the busy row's checkbox was disabled.
   Ticking row A and then clicking row B swallowed the click with no feedback. The guard
   is now scoped to the same participant.
4. **A paid mark could be fabricated on a finished tournament.** The endpoint originally
   had no tournament-status gate at all, so `paid: true` was accepted on an archived or
   completed tournament. Marking a fee paid now requires `REGISTRATION_OPEN` or
   `UPCOMING`. Clearing the mark stays ungated, because refunds are raised after the
   event has run.

The first three were found by reading the code against the toggle cycle the UI allows.
The fourth was found by comparing this endpoint against its siblings. None of them failed
a test first, which is why a case was added for each afterwards.

### Mutation check on the refund guard

The repeat-untick test was verified to be able to fail. With the guard reverted to
`if (completedPayment)`, the suite goes to 12 passed / 1 failed. Restored, it passes. A
guard test that passes against unguarded code proves nothing, so this was run rather than
assumed.

### Tournament-status gates: what was actually verified

Measured, not assumed:

| Method | File and line | Gate |
|---|---|---|
| `addTeamMember` | `tournament-registration.service.ts:769-774` | requires `REGISTRATION_OPEN` or `UPCOMING` |
| `withdraw` | `tournament-registration.service.ts:871-875` | rejects `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED` |
| `kickParticipant` | `tournament-registration.service.ts:1091-1117` | none; authorization only |
| `updateParticipantStatus` | `tournament-participant-admin.service.ts:202-206` | requires `REGISTRATION_OPEN` |
| `setParticipantFeePaid` | this change | `paid` requires `REGISTRATION_OPEN` or `UPCOMING`; `paid: false` ungated |

So there is no single house pattern to copy: the operations disagree with each other.
The split applied here is therefore a judgement, not a transcription:

- **Tick** is gated, because it asserts money is in hand. Leaving it open let an
  organizer stamp "paid" onto any finished tournament.
- **Untick** is ungated, because refunding after the event is normal and legitimate. A
  gate here would break the case the feature exists for.

This remains an **open decision for the user**: if they want unmarking restricted to the
registration window too, or ticking allowed on a completed tournament for late
collections, that is a one-line change with a matching test.

### Known limitation, not fixed

`findCompletedParticipantPaymentInTx` is `LIMIT 1`, newest first. If a participant ever
ends up with two completed payments that are both unrefunded, un-ticking raises a refund
for the newest only and the older one stays captured while `is_paid` goes false. This is a
pre-existing assumption of the whole refund design, shared by every existing caller of
that helper, so it is reported rather than silently changed.

### Verification

- Service spec: 15 passed. The refund-guard test was shown to fail when the guard is
  removed.
- Backend types: unchanged relative to `HEAD` for the three pre-existing spec files.
- Web types and lint: clean for the four files in this change.
- Browser: three checkbox states, both confirmations, and tick-without-dialog all
  observed; the throwaway harness was deleted.

### Working tree note

Both repositories also contain unrelated in-progress edits made by the user while this
work was running: `gender.helper.ts`, `tournament-registration.repository.ts`,
`QuickTournamentCreate.tsx`, the doubles registration flow, and a new
`quickTournamentFormats.ts`. None were touched or staged. The fourth backend type error,
in `tournament-import-legacy-contract.spec.ts`, comes from the user's
`tournament-registration.repository.ts` change, not from this one.

## Requirements

## The one judgement call

The refund policy charges the platform fee on a withdrawal after three hours and waives
it when the organizer kicks someone. An organizer un-ticking a fee is a correction, not
a withdrawal, so `KICKED` was chosen and the full remaining amount comes back. It cannot
be milked: `refund_status` leaves null once per payment, and a manual mark never creates
a second payment row to refund. Recorded in `02-backend-feature-design.md`.

## Goal
Complete the organizer **Thêm VĐV** flow at `/organizer/tournaments/[id]/manage?tab=registration`—friends, club members, direct entry and Excel—plus per-player ELO consent, roster authorization, fees, notes, presence, notifications, and Web/Flutter compatibility. Keep this separate from **Gán suất đặc cách**.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Work on branch `omp/issue-9`; user requires tests/build and a commit with message: `feat: complete handoff tasks for [Handoff] Hoàn thiện luồng Thêm VĐV và consent/ELO giải đấu`.
- Do not push or run migrations against a real database without approval. Do not stage secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, or production PII.
- Friends must satisfy `status='ACCEPTED' AND deletedAt IS NULL`; re-check eligibility and permissions when writing the roster; omit people already rostered.
- Email is genuinely optional. Link an account only when its email is verified; design a safe claim path for people without accounts. Preserve existing field names and optionality for Web/Flutter.
- Consent is one-way and per roster user: it must not block participation; only the player confirms; no organizer ELO-confirmation column or resend button; do not invent reminder intervals. Maximum three automatic reminders.
- ELO must fail closed: empty roster is ineligible; all roster users on both sides must consent; consent is not retroactive. Review enqueue/apply/replay and `updateMatchElo`; keep `insertAdminEloHistory` outside the tournament gate.
- Fees use only `entryFeeAtRegistration`, and payment appears only when the snapshot is greater than zero. Notes are short and at the end of the list. `is_present` is independent of play eligibility/ELO. Do not filter by gender. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.
- Scheduler/email requirements: escaped output, skip players removed from roster and ended tournaments, prevent duplicates across instances, and handle retries/counters correctly.
- Follow `ui-ux-pro-max` and `backend/docs/skills.md`; obtain compliance-owner review without claiming legal compliance.

## Progress

### Done
- [x] Read the relevant skills: brainstorming, writing-plans, TDD, UI/UX, API/interface design, backward compatibility, and API security.
- [x] Created/switched backend, Web, and Flutter repos to `omp/issue-9`. The assistant reported all three worktrees clean before starting; no implementation changes, tests, commits, or pushes are recorded.
- [x] Surveyed relevant consent, ELO, roster, avatar, and UI code. Existing consent is per roster user and the outbox apply gate exists; `updateMatchElo` appears to be a bypass, and the reminder scheduler needs inactive-roster/tournament checks and cross-instance deduplication.
- [x] Located existing Web avatar identity component `web/src/components/ui/ParticipantIdentity.tsx`; verify its real API/data contract before adding or changing avatar APIs.

### In Progress
- [ ] Continue repository/API and client-contract review, then complete the required workflow artifacts before production implementation.
- [ ] TDD implementation across backend, Web, and Flutter; no production changes have been made yet.
- [ ] Verify current branch/worktree state before edits and again before committing.

### Blocked
- [ ] The requested workflow folder and `workflow/harness/validate-workflow.ps1` were not found in the checked-out workspace. Related examples exist under `web/changes/organizer-fee-paid-checkbox-20261005/`; do not claim the strict validator passed while unavailable.
- [ ] No compliance-owner review is recorded. Feature Impact Review and the required VietnamCompliance profile review are prerequisites before implementation.
- [ ] Handoff noted a prior uncommitted backend `.env.example` change; the assistant later reported current backend/Web/Flutter worktrees clean. Recheck status before staging.

## Key Decisions
- **Use existing contracts where possible**: inspect the avatar API/data first and avoid a new or changed avatar API if existing functionality suffices.
- **Keep organizer roster addition distinct from wildcard assignment**.
- **Do not assume Flutter needs an organizer add UI**: inspect existing registration/roster consumers and preserve backward compatibility.
- **No completion claim yet**: no feature implementation or verification has occurred.

## Next Steps
1. Verify `git status` and branch `omp/issue-9` in backend, Web, and Flutter; locate or establish the task workflow artifacts and determine the canonical validator location.
2. Complete the problem map, discovery/contract, Feature Impact Review, screen/button/cross-platform matrices, entity/backend design, endpoint contract, screen spec, compliance scope, plan/tasks, and test/release evidence; update README status and record compliance-owner review.
3. Confirm candidate APIs and permissions; define safe optional-email/account-claim behavior; verify registration consent UI paths and Flutter/Web contracts. Write regression tests first.
4. Implement the distinct add-athlete flow and address consent/ELO gates, reminder safety, fee snapshot, notes, presence, notifications, and responsive/accessibility states.
5. Run relevant tests, typechecks/builds, migration validation, and browser/UI smoke tests. Check previously reported backend typecheck errors rather than relying on old results. Run strict workflow validation if the script becomes available. Do not run a real-DB migration.
6. Review diffs and secrets, then commit required changes on `omp/issue-9` with the exact requested commit message. Do not push.

## Critical Context
- Key inspected backend files include `backend/src/modules/tournaments/services/ranking-consent.service.ts`, `backend/src/modules/tournaments/tournament-scheduler.service.ts`, `backend/src/modules/rankings/elo-outbox.processor.ts`, `backend/src/modules/rankings/rankings.service.ts`, and `backend/src/modules/matches/matches.repository.ts`. Relevant names include `updateMatchElo` and `insertAdminEloHistory`.
- Web registration UI: `web/src/app/organizer/tournaments/[id]/manage/components/RegistrationTab.tsx`; avatar identity: `web/src/components/ui/ParticipantIdentity.tsx`.
- Flutter surfaces/models inspected include `app/lib/domain/entities/organizer_ops.dart`, `app/lib/data/repositories/api/api_tournament_repository.dart`, and `app/lib/features/organizer_ops/screens/organizer_ops_screen.dart`.
- Original handoff references backend checkpoint `b3d4b92` and Web checkpoint `f0444d51` on `omp/handoff-current-session-20261006`; it explicitly says those checkpoints do **not** contain the add-athlete implementation. No session upload was confirmed.

## Additional Notes
- The prior handoff states no tests, typechecks, migration validation, or browser tests were run. This session also records none.
- Do not infer or invent reminder timing; anchor/deduplication/retry semantics still require review.

---

**Turn Context (split turn):**

## Original Request
- Carry out a cross-platform tournament-registration change on `omp/issue-9`, covering backend, Web, and Flutter. The checklist includes adding roster members via friends/club or direct entry alongside Excel import; safe account linking and guest claiming; player-controlled, non-blocking ELO consent; fee snapshots and organizer notes; ELO and reminder safeguards; workflow artifacts; tests and release checks.
- Preserve existing API fields and compatibility. Do not run a real migration, claim legal compliance, push, or open a PR without required approvals.

## Early Progress
- The branch/workflow check and existing-contract inventory were marked complete. The checkout was reported to lack workflow artifacts and `workflow/harness/validate-workflow.ps1`; no compliance owner had been identified.

- The assistant compared three approaches and recommended separate, tournament-scoped candidate/add APIs, keeping Excel/direct entry separate. The proposal also covered verified-email-only account linking and guest claims, per-player one-way consent, fail-closed ELO gates, fee snapshots, and safer reminder handling.
- No code, spec/plan, or commit had been made at the end of the visible prefix. The assistant was awaiting approval of the design, and the corresponding checklist task was blocked pending that approval.

## Context for Suffix
- The retained work resumes with further contract, test, and ELO-path investigation. It runs `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false` from `backend`; the tool output is obscured, though subsequent assistant notes refer to eight diagnostics.
- Relevant ELO locations identified in the suffix include `backend/src/modules/rankings/rankings.service.ts` (`recalculateEloChain`, `updateMatchElo`) and `backend/src/modules/rankings/recalculate-elo-consent.spec.ts`. The inspected replay gate requires nonempty roster rows and consent before match completion on each side.

# 🛠️ 8 Kỹ Năng Cốt Lõi (Tech Skills Map)

> Tài liệu này quy định **chính xác** 8 nhóm kỹ năng cần thiết để xây dựng dự án.  
> Mỗi kỹ năng được **map trực tiếp** với nghiệp vụ thực tế từ `database_schema.md`, `plan.md`, `apicrud.md`.  
> **AI Agent hoặc thành viên mới:** Hãy đọc file này TRƯỚC KHI viết bất kỳ dòng code nào.

---

## 🤖 QUY TẮC BẮT BUỘC DÀNH CHO AI AGENT (GRAPHIFY PROTOCOL)

Nhằm tối ưu **Token Quota** và tăng tốc độ hiểu dự án, mọi AI Agent tham gia vào dự án này (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, v.v.) **BẮT BUỘC** phải tuân thủ quy trình sau:

1. **KHÔNG đọc mù mã nguồn (Blind Reading):** Khi nhận được yêu cầu thêm tính năng mới, AI **KHÔNG ĐƯỢC** dùng các công cụ `grep` hoặc `cat` chạy rà soát toàn bộ hàng trăm file mã nguồn.
2. **Sử dụng Graphify làm Nguồn Sự Thật (Source of Truth):** AI phải tự động nạp hoặc tham chiếu tới thư mục `graphify-out/` (cụ thể là `graph.json` và `GRAPH_REPORT.md`) để nắm bắt kiến trúc tổng thể, luồng gọi hàm (AST) và sự liên kết giữa các file.
3. **Cập nhật Graphify sau mỗi Feature lớn:** 
   - Sau khi hoàn thành code cho một module mới hoặc sửa đổi cấu trúc diện rộng, AI **phải** chủ động chạy lệnh `graphify update .` trên Terminal.
   - Quá trình này không tiêu tốn API key LLM (No LLM needed) và chỉ mất vài giây để quét lại cây AST nội bộ. Nhờ đó, Knowledge Graph luôn tươi mới (Freshness = 100%) cho các lượt Prompt tiếp theo.

---

## Skill 1: Backend Core — NestJS + TypeScript 🏗️

> **Nền tảng của toàn bộ hệ thống.** Mọi API, logic, module đều chạy trên NestJS.

| Công nghệ | Phiên bản | Vai trò trong dự án |
|---|---|---|
| **Node.js** | >= 20 LTS | Runtime |
| **TypeScript** | >= 5.x (Strict mode) | Ngôn ngữ chính — **KHÔNG dùng JS, KHÔNG dùng `any`** |
| **NestJS** | >= 11.x | Framework Modular Monolith |

> **Dòng tiền.** Thu phí giải đấu, cắt hoa hồng, rút tiền cho BTC. Sai = mất tiền thật.

| Công nghệ | Phiên bản | Vai trò trong dự án |

| **VNPay SDK** | Latest | Cổng thanh toán chính (sandbox + production) |

### Phải biết gì?
- **Payment Flow**:
  1. User đăng ký giải có phí → Tạo `payments` record (`status: PENDING`)
  2. Redirect user sang VNPay/MoMo checkout page
  3. User thanh toán → Gateway gọi **Webhook callback** về server
  4. Server verify signature → **Transaction ACID**:
     - Update `payments.status = 'SUCCESSFUL'`
     - Update `tournament_participants.is_paid = true`
     - Insert `payment_status_logs` (lưu vết)
     - Tính `platform_fee_amount = amount * platform_fee_percentage / 100`
- **Idempotency**: Dùng `transaction_reference` (UNIQUE) chống webhook gọi đúp
- **Payout Flow**: BTC yêu cầu rút → Admin duyệt → Upload ảnh bill → Đổi status
- **ACID bắt buộc**: Mọi thao tác tiền PHẢI bọc trong `db.transaction()`

## Skill 6: Domain Logic — ELO, Bracket, Giải đấu 🧠

> **Nghiệp vụ đặc thù thể thao.** Thuật toán ELO, sinh nhánh đấu, quản lý multi-stage.

### 6.1 Hệ thống ELO & Xếp hạng

| Khái niệm | Chi tiết |
|---|---|
| **ELO Algorithm** | K-factor based — tính toán khi match `COMPLETED` |
| **Tier System** | Low D → High D → C → B → Low A → High A (theo `elo_tiers`) |
| **Per-Category** | Mỗi user có ELO riêng cho mỗi môn (Pickleball, Tennis, Cầu lông) |
| **Race Condition** | `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` trên `user_ranks` khi cập nhật ELO |

#### Phải biết gì?
- **ELO Formula**: `new_elo = old_elo + K * (actual_score - expected_score)`
  - `expected_score = 1 / (1 + 10^((opponent_elo - player_elo) / 400))`
  - K-factor tùy theo tier (K=32 cho new player, K=16 cho player ổn định)
- **Match → ELO Event**: Khi `matches.status = 'COMPLETED'` → trigger Event:
  1. Lấy danh sách `match_players` (ai thực sự ra sân)
  2. Lock `user_ranks` cho mỗi player (`FOR UPDATE`)
  3. Tính ELO mới cho winner + loser
  4. Update `user_ranks.elo_points`, `matches_played`, `matches_won`
  5. Auto-update `tier_id` nếu ELO vượt ngưỡng
  6. Insert `elo_history_logs` (lưu previous → new, reason: `MATCH_WIN`/`MATCH_LOSS`)
- **Leaderboard**: Query `user_ranks` ORDER BY `elo_points DESC` theo `category_id`

### 6.2 Bracket Generation (Sinh nhánh đấu)

| Thể thức | Mô tả |
|---|---|
| **Round Robin** | Mỗi đội gặp nhau 1 lần → tính `group_standings` → top N lên vòng sau |
| **Single Elimination** | Thua 1 trận = loại. Dùng `matches.next_match_id` tạo cây bracket |
| **Double Elimination** | Thua lần 1 xuống nhánh phụ (`loser_next_match_id`); chung kết tổng là một trận quyết định cuối cùng |

#### Phải biết gì?
- **Self-referencing**: `matches.next_match_id` → `matches.id` tạo bracket tree
- **Bracket seeding**: Sắp xếp `tournament_participants.seed` để hạt giống không gặp nhau sớm
- **Stage transition**: Round Robin xong → lấy top N từ `group_standings` → seed vào Elimination stage
- **Bảng điều phối**: `matches(group_id, round_number, match_order, bracket_branch)` — xác định vị trí chính xác trên bracket

### Dùng ở đâu trong dự án?
- Bảng: `user_ranks`, `elo_tiers`, `elo_history_logs`, `match_players`, `tournament_stages`, `tournament_groups`, `matches`, `group_standings`
- `plan.md` Phase 2.3 (Bracket), Phase 2.4 (Matches), Phase 2.5 (ELO)

> **Giao diện người dùng.** Dashboard giải đấu, Live Score board, Chat, Leaderboard.

# Problem Map - organizer-fee-paid-checkbox-20261005

## Problem statement

In the organizer `Đăng ký & Vận động viên` tab the registration fee is shown as a
read-only status badge: a green tick when `participant.isPaid`, a grey cross when not.
An organizer who collects the fee in cash or by bank transfer has no way to record
it, so the roster cannot be finalised even though the money is in hand.

The request: make that column a checkbox the organizer controls directly, with these
rules.

| Action | Meaning | Money |
|---|---|---|
| Tick | "I have this person's fee" — a manual mark, used for cash/bank transfer | none moves |
| Untick, no system payment | undo a manual mark | no refund, nothing financial |
| Untick, system payment exists | return the money | creates a refund request |

Unticking must warn first, because one of the two cases creates a refund.

## Evidence

| # | Evidence |
|---|---|
| E1 | `RegistrationTab.tsx:913-922` (before) rendered a green circle with `Check` when `participant.isPaid`, else a grey `X`. No control. |
| E2 | `tournament_participants.is_paid` is a denormalised boolean. The only normal writer is `transitionPayment` (`payments.repository.ts:355-361`) when a gateway payment completes. |
| E3 | `PATCH :id/participants/:participantId` (`tournaments.controller.ts:1568-1586`) accepts only `status`. No fee flag. |
| E4 | `TournamentParticipant.payment` is nullable (`types/tournament.ts:332-343`). A manual mark produces no payment row, so `payment == null` is exactly the "no system payment" case. |
| E5 | Refunds are two-phase. Request: `createPendingRefund` (`tournament-payment.repository.ts:199-246`) CAS-flips `refund_status` NULL to `PENDING_REFUND` and inserts one `payment_refunds` row. Settle: `POST /payments/admin/payments/:id/confirm-refund`, `@Roles(ADMIN)` only, needs a proof URL. No gateway reversal call exists anywhere. |
| E6 | `createPendingRefund` takes the amount as input, but every existing caller derives it from `calculateTournamentRefundQuote` (`utils/tournament-refund-policy.ts:40`). The amount is never caller-supplied. |
| E7 | `financial_ledger_entries.idempotency_key` is `notNull().unique()` (`payments.schema.ts:222`), and the refund request CAS makes a second request for the same payment impossible. |

## Consequences the design must respect

- **The endpoint may request a refund, never execute one.** Settlement stays admin-only.
- **No new schema.** `is_paid`, `refund_status` and `payment_refunds` already carry everything.
- **The refund amount must come from the policy helper**, never from the client or a
  hand-rolled calculation.
- **Ownership is `TournamentAccessService.isManager`**, matching every other participant
  mutation, not an organization column.

## Out of scope

- Changing who can settle refunds.
- Partial refunds — the existing API cannot express one.
- Any change to the payment capture path.

# Feature Impact Review - organizer-fee-paid-checkbox-20261005

Decision: GO_WITH_CONDITIONS

## Decision

GO_WITH_CONDITIONS. The change is confined to one organizer table and one new
organizer endpoint, and it never moves money by itself: the worst case is a refund
*request* that still has to be settled by an admin through the pre-existing
`confirm-refund` route. The condition is that refund settlement and its audit trail
stay exactly as they are.

## Source of truth

- Refund policy: `calculateTournamentRefundQuote`
  (`src/modules/tournaments/utils/tournament-refund-policy.ts:40`). Amounts are never
  taken from the client or hand-computed.
- Refund request: `TournamentPaymentRepository.createPendingRefund`
  (`tournament-payment.repository.ts:199`), which compare-and-sets
  `payments.refund_status` NULL to `PENDING_REFUND` and refuses a second request.
- Refund settlement: `PaymentsRepository.confirmLegacyRefund`
  (`payments.repository.ts:702`), reachable only through
  `POST /payments/admin/payments/:id/confirm-refund`, `@Roles(ADMIN)`.
- Fee state: `tournament_participants.is_paid`. "Paid through the system" means a
  `payments` row exists with `status = 'COMPLETED'` and `purpose = 'REGISTRATION_FEE'`,
  which is exactly what `findCompletedParticipantPaymentInTx` looks up.
- Authorization: `TournamentAccessService.isManager`, the same check every other
  participant mutation uses.

## Affected

| Area | Change |
|---|---|
| Backend, `tournaments.controller.ts` | new `PATCH :id/participants/:participantId/fee-payment` |
| Backend, `tournament-participant-admin.service.ts` | new `setParticipantFeePaid`, audit + broadcast |
| Backend, `tournament-payment.repository.ts` | `setParticipantPaidInTx` (the transactional flag write) |
| Backend, new DTO | `UpdateParticipantFeePaymentDto { paid }` |
| Backend, two spec files | constructor arity only |
| Web, `RegistrationTab.tsx` | payment badge replaced by a checkbox plus a confirmation |
| Web, `features/tournaments/api.ts` | `setParticipantFeePaid` client |
| Web, `messages/vi.json`, `messages/en.json` | 11 keys each |
| Schema | none |
| Payments module | none |

## Negative cases

| Case | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Caller does not manage the tournament | 403, no transaction opened |
| Participant belongs to another tournament | 404 |
| Flag already equals the requested value | no-op: no transaction, no audit row, no broadcast |
| Tick with no payment row | sets the flag only, creates no `payments` row |
| Untick with no payment row | clears the flag, no refund row, no money movement |
| Untick with a COMPLETED payment and `refund_status` NULL | policy quote, one `PENDING_REFUND` request, audit on both rows |
| Untick twice across a tick in between | second call skips the request instead of hitting the compare-and-set, so the flag is not rolled back |
| Payment already refunded or refund pending | flag still clears, `refundRequested` reports `false` |
| Concurrent unticks | the compare-and-set inside `createPendingRefund` keeps exactly one request; the loser throws inside the transaction, so nothing partially applies |
| Client double-click | the row's checkbox is disabled while its mutation is in flight |

## Security

- The endpoint can only ever *request* a refund. Moving money still requires the
  admin-only settlement route and a proof URL.
- Ownership re-checked server-side; the client never decides eligibility.
- The refund amount is computed server-side by the shared policy. There is no code
  path where a client-supplied number reaches `payment_refunds.amount`.
- Every write is audited inside the same transaction via `AuditService.logUpdate`.
- A repeat refund for the same payment is impossible at both the
  `refund_status` compare-and-set and the unique
  `financial_ledger_entries.idempotency_key`.

## Conditions

1. Do not relax the admin-only settlement route.
2. Re-run `validate-workflow.ps1 -Strict` after the two other in-progress worktrees
   in this workspace are committed, since they are unrelated.

## Evidence

- `npx jest src/modules/tournaments/services/tournament-participant-admin.service.spec.ts`
  → 13 passed. Includes 403, cross-tournament 404, idempotent no-op, mark-paid
  creates no payment row, refund requested through the policy quote, manual mark
  skipped, and a repeat-untick case that asserts no second refund is raised.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` on the backend: the error set is unchanged from `HEAD` for the
  three pre-existing spec files. A fourth spec,
  `tournament-import-legacy-contract.spec.ts`, errors only because of unrelated
  in-progress edits to `tournament-registration.repository.ts` in the same working
  tree.
- Browser, 1568x833, real `RegistrationTab` with a stubbed mutation: three
  participants render correct checkbox states; unticking a manual mark opens the
  neutral confirmation; unticking a system payment opens the danger confirmation
  with a red action; ticking applies immediately with no dialog.

displayContent.text:
# Security Delta - organizer-fee-paid-checkbox-20261005

## Trust boundary

The organizer UI is authenticated but not trusted for anything financial. Every
decision that could move money is taken server-side.

## What was added

A new organizer-reachable write path: `tournament_participants.is_paid`.

## Controls

| Control | Where | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Authentication | global `JwtAuthGuard` | inherited from the module, same as every sibling route |
| Role | `@Roles(UserRole.ORGANIZER, UserRole.ADMIN)` on the new route | an end player cannot reach it |
| Ownership | `tournamentAccessService.isManager(tournament, userId, systemRoles)` inside the service | the role alone is not enough; the caller must actually manage this tournament |
| Cross-tournament | `participant.tournamentId !== tournamentId` → 404 | prevents acting on a participant id from another tournament |
| Idempotency | early return when the flag already matches | no transaction, no audit, no broadcast; no write amplification from retries |
| Atomicity | one `db.transaction` around the refund request and the flag write | a failure can never leave the flag cleared with no refund recorded |
| Amount integrity | `calculateTournamentRefundQuote` computes the amount | the client has no field for it and no path to influence it |
| Double refund | `createPendingRefund` compare-and-sets `refund_status IS NULL`; `financial_ledger_entries.idempotency_key` is unique and not null | two independent barriers, one of them enforced by the database |
| Audit | `AuditService.logUpdate` on the participant row and, when a refund is requested, on the payment row | who flipped it and what it cost, recorded in the same transaction |

## What was deliberately not added

- No way to execute a refund. `confirm-refund` stays `@Roles(ADMIN)` and still
  requires a transaction proof URL.
- No client-supplied amount, reason enum, or participant status.
- No new table, column, enum value or migration, so there is no new attack surface
  on the data layer.
- No mass action. One row, one request, so a bulk mistake cannot happen.

## Client-side

- The checkbox is disabled while its own mutation is in flight, preventing a
  double-submit from one row.
- The confirmation text states that a refund request is being created and that the
  organizer still has to transfer the money back. It never quotes an amount,
  because the client cannot know it.
- Nothing sensitive is rendered that the organizer could not already see.

## Residual risk

An organizer can mark a fee paid without any proof, which is the intended override.
The audit row is the only record of who did it. If that is unacceptable for a
deployment, the follow-up is an optional note or receipt field on the manual mark —
deliberately not built here because no such column exists and inventing one was
out of scope.

import {
  pgTable,
  uuid,
  varchar,
  text,
  boolean,
  timestamp,
  date,
  integer,
  unique,
  uniqueIndex,
} from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core';
import { provinces } from './regions.schema';
import { tournaments } from './tournaments.schema';


export const users = pgTable('users', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  email: varchar('email', { length: 255 }).notNull().unique(),
  passwordHash: text('password_hash'),
  isEmailVerified: boolean('is_email_verified').default(false).notNull(),
  isPhoneVerified: boolean('is_phone_verified').default(false).notNull(),
  isMock: boolean('is_mock').default(false).notNull(),
  acceptedTosAt: timestamp('accepted_tos_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
  deletedAt: timestamp('deleted_at', { withTimezone: true }),
});

export const authProviders = pgTable('auth_providers', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id')
    .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
    .notNull(),
  provider: varchar('provider', { length: 50 }).notNull(),
  providerUserId: varchar('provider_user_id', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  providerEmail: varchar('provider_email', { length: 255 }),
  providerAvatarUrl: text('provider_avatar_url'),
  providerDisplayName: varchar('provider_display_name', { length: 255 }),
  accessToken: text('access_token'),
  refreshToken: text('refresh_token'),
  tokenExpiresAt: timestamp('token_expires_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
}, (table) => ({
  providerUserUnique: unique().on(table.provider, table.providerUserId),
}));

export const roles = pgTable('roles', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 100 }).notNull().unique(),
  slug: varchar('slug', { length: 100 }).notNull().unique(),
  description: text('description'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
});

export const userToRoles = pgTable('user_to_roles', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id')
    .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
    .notNull(),
  roleId: uuid('role_id')
    .references(() => roles.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
    .notNull(),
  assignedAt: timestamp('assigned_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
  assignedBy: uuid('assigned_by').references(() => users.id, {
    onDelete: 'set null',
  }),
}, (table) => ({
  userRoleUnique: uniqueIndex('user_to_roles_user_id_role_id_unique').on(
    table.userId,
    table.roleId,
  ),
}));

export const profiles = pgTable('profiles', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id')
    .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
    .notNull()
    .unique(),
  fullName: varchar('full_name', { length: 255 }).notNull(),
  avatarUrl: text('avatar_url'),
  coverUrl: text('cover_url'),
  phoneNumber: varchar('phone_number', { length: 20 }),
  dateOfBirth: date('date_of_birth'),
  gender: varchar('gender', { length: 20 }),
  isGenderLocked: boolean('is_gender_locked').default(false).notNull(),
  address: text('address'),
  bio: text('bio'),
  provinceCode: varchar('province_code', { length: 20 })
    .references(() => provinces.code, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  isVerified: boolean('is_verified').default(false).notNull(),
  // Quyền riêng tư nhắn tin: false = chặn người lạ nhắn tin; opt-in mới là true.
  allowStrangerMessages: boolean('allow_stranger_messages').default(false).notNull(),
  bankName: varchar('bank_name', { length: 100 }),
  bankAccountNumber: varchar('bank_account_number', { length: 50 }),
  bankAccountName: varchar('bank_account_name', { length: 255 }),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
});

export const sessions = pgTable('sessions', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id')
    .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
    .notNull(),
  refreshToken: text('refresh_token').notNull().unique(),
  userAgent: text('user_agent'),
  ipAddress: varchar('ip_address', { length: 45 }),
  isRevoked: boolean('is_revoked').default(false).notNull(),
  revokedAt: timestamp('revoked_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  expiresAt: timestamp('expires_at', { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
});

export const organizerReviews = pgTable('organizer_reviews', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  organizerId: uuid('organizer_id').references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }).notNull(),
  reviewerId: uuid('reviewer_id').references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'restrict' }).notNull(),
  tournamentId: uuid('tournament_id').references(() => tournaments.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }).notNull(),
  rating: integer('rating').notNull(),
  comment: text('comment'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }).defaultNow().notNull(),
});

export const userChangeRequests = pgTable('user_change_requests', {
  id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  userId: uuid('user_id')
    .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' })
    .notNull(),
  requestType: varchar('request_type', { length: 50 }).notNull(), // 'GENDER', 'EMAIL'
  oldValue: text('old_value').notNull(),
  newValue: text('new_value').notNull(),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 50 }).default('PENDING').notNull(), // 'PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'
  adminNote: text('admin_note'),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true })
    .defaultNow()
    .notNull(),
});

# Problem Map — organizer-add-athlete-consent-20261005

## Vấn đề

Tab đăng ký của organizer hiện có nhập danh sách từ biểu mẫu/bảng tính, nhưng chưa có luồng riêng để thêm bạn bè, thành viên CLB hoặc ghi danh trực tiếp. Trường ELO consent hiện bắt buộc ở một số form đăng ký Web/Flutter, dù nghiệp vụ yêu cầu người chơi vẫn được tham gia khi từ chối hoặc chưa xác nhận. Luồng guest chưa có cơ chế claim an toàn.

Yêu cầu là bổ sung luồng **Thêm VĐV** độc lập với Excel và **Gán suất đặc cách**, đồng thời giữ API/field cũ tương thích. Mỗi roster user tự xác nhận ELO; consent không cản trở tham gia và không hồi tố. Organizer không được thay mặt người chơi xác nhận.

## Bất biến

| # | Quy tắc |
|---|---|
| R1 | Candidate bạn bè chỉ khi quan hệ `ACCEPTED` và `deletedAt IS NULL`; ghi roster phải kiểm tra lại. |
| R2 | Candidate CLB phải đang `JOINED` trong CLB gắn với giải; ghi roster phải kiểm tra lại. |
| R3 | Không trả candidate đã nằm trong roster đang hoạt động của giải/nội dung. |
| R4 | Email optional; chỉ gắn tài khoản có `isEmailVerified=true`; guest cần claim token dùng một lần, lưu hash và chỉ claim bởi user đã xác minh. |
| R5 | Consent theo từng `tournament_rosters.userId`, một chiều, tự xác nhận; trận chỉ tính nếu hoàn tất sau consent của mọi roster user hai bên. Roster rỗng/guest chưa claim fail-closed. |
| R6 | Fee snapshot lấy server-side từ `entryFeeAtRegistration`; không đọc fee hiện tại để hiển thị giao dịch cũ. Chỉ hiện payment khi snapshot `> 0`. |
| R7 | Note ngắn; hiển thị cuối dòng. `isPresent` độc lập với trạng thái thi đấu và ELO. Không lọc giới tính. |
| R8 | Scheduler bỏ roster đã remove và giải `COMPLETED`/`CANCELLED`; escape HTML; không gửi trùng đồng thời giữa instances; lỗi gửi không tăng counter. |
| R9 | Timestamps trả về ISO-8601 UTC. Không chạy migration trên DB thật, không push, không tự xác nhận tuân thủ pháp lý. |

## Bằng chứng trạng thái hiện tại

- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/tournaments.controller.ts:1491-1543`: đã có route preview/commit Excel; route mới không thay thế các route này.
- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/repositories/tournament-import.repository.ts:249-397`: strict roster import yêu cầu email và resolve account IDs; `:399-567` là legacy import riêng.
- `backend/src/database/schema/tournaments.schema.ts:241-279`: roster `userId` bắt buộc; consent timestamp và reminder counters đã có.
- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/repositories/tournament-participant.repository.ts:107-177`: consent hiện chỉ ghi roster row của chính người chơi và idempotent.
- `web/src/app/(public)/tournaments/[id]/components/RegisterModal.tsx:36-47` và `DoublesRegistrationFlow.tsx:417-425`: Web chặn đăng ký nếu chưa consent.
- `app/lib/features/register/screens/tournament_register_screen.dart:537-555`: Flutter chặn đăng ký nếu chưa consent; `football_team_register_screen.dart:251-262` gửi `rankingConsent: true`.
- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/services/ranking-consent.service.ts:17-20,42-109`: giới hạn hiện tại 3 notification tổng, delay hiện hữu 24h/72h; không đổi lịch.
- `backend/src/modules/rankings/rankings.service.ts:1787-1834,2034-2073`: replay đã kiểm consent theo từng phía nhưng query không giới hạn `isRanked`.
- `backend/src/modules/rankings/rankings.service.ts:264-306`: `updateMatchElo` kiểm match completed/ranked nhưng chưa kiểm consent.
- `backend/src/database/schema/tournaments.schema.ts:208-217`: `isPresent` và `entryFeeAtRegistration` đã có; participant schema không có organizer note.

## Ngoài phạm vi

- Không thay Excel, không gọi hoặc thay luồng wildcard/cấp suất đặc cách.
- Không tự đặt reminder schedule mới, không thêm organizer consent status/resend UI.
- Không thay luật tính ELO chung; `insertAdminEloHistory` tiếp tục ngoài gate giải đấu.
- Không thực thi migration/DB production, không tạo chứng nhận compliance.

# Discovery Brief — organizer-add-athlete-consent-20261005

## Câu hỏi

Có thể tái sử dụng những phần nào để thêm VĐV thật mà không nhập nhằng Excel/wildcard và không vượt quyền hay consent?

## Kết quả khảo sát

| # | Phát hiện | Bằng chứng |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Excel/legacy import là hai route riêng; strict route yêu cầu email, legacy có email tùy chọn và metadata riêng. | `tournaments.controller.ts:1491-1543`; `tournament-import.repository.ts:254-397,404-567`. |
| D2 | Import liên kết roster theo ID account tìm được; đoạn `persistImportRows` không kiểm `isEmailVerified`. | `tournament-import.repository.ts:339-378,621-670`; schema `users.schema.ts:17-22`. |
| D3 | Friendship repository chỉ lọc `deletedAt IS NULL`; method `listActiveForUser` không lọc `status`. Candidate API phải thêm cả `status='ACCEPTED'` và lặp lại ở write. | `friendships.repository.ts:77-91`. |
| D4 | CLB có membership `status='JOINED'`; `CommunitiesRepository.getMembers` có phân trang/search và có thể tái dùng quy ước, nhưng route mới phải ràng buộc communityId lấy từ tournament. | `communities.repository.ts:606-679`. |
| D5 | `tournament_rosters.userId` NOT NULL, consent timestamp theo user; guest chưa claim không thể được giả làm roster user. | `tournaments.schema.ts:241-279`. |
| D6 | Không có note organizer cấp participant trong schema hiện tại. `isPresent` và snapshot fee đã có sẵn. | `tournaments.schema.ts:184-239`. |
| D7 | `confirmRankingConsent` tự ghi timestamp idempotent; cần route player-facing cho người được organizer thêm/guest vừa claim. | `tournament-participant.repository.ts:107-177`. |
| D8 | Import service đã có notification success/pending và consent request; luồng mới nên tái dùng builders/services, không tự tạo email consent thứ hai. | `tournament-import.service.ts:58-85,103-127,160-216`. |
| D9 | Reminder hiện chọn mọi roster chưa consent trong giải ranked; chưa lọc roster removed/tournament ended, build HTML dùng dữ liệu động trực tiếp và update counter không atomic multi-instance. | `ranking-consent.service.ts:42-109,118-224`. |
| D10 | ELO apply kiểm `completedAt` và consent từng user; replay có consent check nhưng thiếu `tournament.isRanked`; manual `updateMatchElo` thiếu consent gate. | `rankings.service.ts:1787-1834,2024-2073,2274-2421,264-306`. |
| D11 | `insertAdminEloHistory` là luồng audit/admin khác, không đưa vào gate consent của tournament. | `rankings.service.ts` direct admin path; kiểm tra symbol trước khi sửa. |

## Lựa chọn

1. Mở rộng Excel/legacy import — **loại**: trộn hành vi và validation hai flow, làm email khó thật sự optional.
2. Thêm API tournament-scoped riêng cho candidate và commit — **chọn**: server lọc/recheck quan hệ, không đụng spreadsheet/wildcard.
3. Tạo `users` giả để giữ roster NOT NULL — **loại**: trộn guest với account thật và làm rối social/ELO.
4. Lưu guest trong bảng riêng và claim thành roster user sau xác thực — **chọn**: fail-closed ELO rõ ràng, email optional, token chỉ dùng một lần.

## Còn cần xác minh khi triển khai

- Tên/enum của trạng thái participant và quy tắc capacity phải dùng helper/repository hiện có.
- Candidate response chỉ cần profile name/avatar; không trả email/phone.
- Claim-email template phải escape text/URL; claim yêu cầu account đã xác minh và khớp contact email khi có.

# Architecture Review — organizer-add-athlete-consent-20261005

- **Status:** `needs-review` (reviewer độc lập chưa được ghi nhận)
- **Owner:** omp coding agent
- **Reviewer:** chưa được xác định
- **Ngày:** 2026-10-05
- **Risk tier:** high
- **Related change:** `organizer-add-athlete-consent-20261005`

## 1. Quyết định

Thêm API organizer tournament-scoped cho candidates/participant, bảng guest claim và note ngắn; giữ Excel/wildcard nguyên trạng; player-only consent tiếp tục theo từng roster user.

## 2. Bối cảnh

- Hiện có participant/roster, `entryFeeAtRegistration`, `isPresent`, consent timestamp và mail scheduler.
- Roster `userId` bắt buộc nên guest chưa claim không thể giả làm account; email và account identity phải tách.
- Chất lượng ưu tiên: authorization recheck, backward compatibility, fail-closed ELO, tránh PII lộ qua candidates.
- Giả định: user yêu cầu riêng flow Add Athlete, không cho phép organizer thay mặt player consent.

## 3. C4 impact

| View | Thay đổi | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| System context | Không | Tích hợp hệ thống hiện có |
| Containers | Có | Backend + Web + Flutter player-consent consumer |
| Components | Có | tournaments, rankings, scheduler/mail, Web RegistrationTab |
| Dynamic flow | Có | candidate → add/guest → claim/self-consent → ELO |
| Deployment | Có | DB migration; không chạy trên DB thật |
| Data flow/trust boundary | Có | email, friendship/club relations, one-time claim credential |

## 4. Lựa chọn

| Lựa chọn | Lợi ích | Chi phí/rủi ro | Quyết định |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mở rộng import Excel | ít endpoint | nhập nhằng email, preview, nguồn và wildcard | loại |
| Tạo candidate/add route riêng | recheck quyền/quan hệ, không phá import | API/schema/UI mới | chọn |
| Account giả cho guest | dùng roster hiện có | tạo danh tính đăng nhập giả, ảnh hưởng ELO/social | loại |
| Bảng guest riêng + one-time claim | không link email chưa xác minh; roster trống fail-closed | migration và claim flow | chọn |

## 5. Thiết kế chọn

- **Boundary:** Tournament module sở hữu candidates/add/claim/note; player consent qua self-service route; RankingsService sở hữu gate ELO.
- **Dependency:** controller → service → repository; notifications và mail sau commit; không gọi wildcard.
- **Data/API:** thêm `organizer_note` (tối đa 280 ký tự), `tournament_guest_rosters` và API mới; response chỉ thêm field optional.
- **Security/privacy:** manager+Verified; accepted friendship/non-deleted và club `JOINED` được recheck trong transaction; claim token hash+single-use; candidate không trả email.
- **Reliability:** lock capacity dùng pattern hiện có; notification fail không rollback participant; reminder row lock/claim ngăn gửi đồng thời.
- **Performance:** phân trang candidates; batch-load avatar/profile; không N+1; chỉ query participant roster theo giải/nội dung.
- **Cost:** một migration và ít mail tăng thêm; không thêm dependency.

## 6. Fitness checks

| ID | Quy tắc | Kiểm tra | Điều kiện pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| ARCH-001 | Excel/wildcard contracts không đổi | regression tests + diff | existing tests pass; route untouched |
| ARCH-002 | relation and owner rechecked on write | service/repository tests | stale friendship/membership rejects |
| ARCH-003 | ELO fails closed | enqueue/apply/replay/manual tests | no empty roster, guest, unranked, late consent scored |
| ARCH-004 | no secrets in output/logs | review + search diff | raw token never logged or stored |
| ARCH-005 | reminder retry/dedupe | concurrent service spec | one simultaneous send; failed send does not increment |

## 7. Delivery/recovery

- Backend tests first; migration SQL reviewed, not applied to real DB; Web UI then Flutter compatibility.
- Additive response fields; old readers ignore them. New frontend tolerates missing optional values.
- Rollback code and migration only if no guest/note data has been written; after data creation migration rollback requires export/retention decision.
- No feature flag exists; do not invent one in this change.
- Observability: reuse scheduler log and existing notification outcomes; do not log email, token, phone or note.

## 8. Waivers

None. Validator absence is not a waiver.

## 9. Review outcome

- **Decision:** `accepted-with-conditions` as an implementation design, not an external approval.
- **Conditions:** compliance owner review and strict workflow validation before release/PR; review user-facing claim retention and consent email.
- **Open risks:** migration not run against staging; mail provider has no confirmed idempotency-key contract; durable exactly-once delivery cannot be claimed.
- **Approval:** no compliance-owner approval recorded.

## 10. Convergence

Pending implementation and test evidence. Do not mark accepted/released until all gates are evidenced.

# Feature Impact Review — organizer-add-athlete-consent-20261005

Decision: **GO_WITH_CONDITIONS**.

## Source of truth

- Tournament/manager ownership: `TournamentAccessService.isManager`, same permission boundary as import.
- Friendship eligibility: `friendships.status='ACCEPTED' AND deletedAt IS NULL`; current `FriendshipsRepository.listActiveForUser` is insufficient by itself (`:77-91`).
- Club eligibility: tournament `communityId` and `community_members.status='JOINED'`.
- Fee: `TournamentPaymentRepository.resolveDivisionEntryFee`; save resulting `entryFeeAtRegistration` on creation. Snapshot field already exists.
- Presence: `tournament_participants.isPresent`, independent.
- Consent: `tournament_rosters.rankingConsentAt`, timestamp written only by that player's own session; no organizer state/control.
- ELO: enqueue, apply, replay and direct `updateMatchElo` must all verify ranked setting and every roster user consented before `completedAt`; `insertAdminEloHistory` excluded.

## Phạm vi ảnh hưởng

| Khu vực | Thay đổi |
|---|---|
| Backend tournaments | New candidate/add/direct/claim/consent routes; note and guest repository/DTOs; manager and source eligibility checks |
| Backend schema | `organizer_note` and `tournament_guest_rosters`; migration generated/reviewed, not applied to real DB |
| Backend rankings | Gate direct update and replay against `isRanked`; ensure enqueue uses completion timestamp; preserve admin history |
| Backend scheduler | active roster/tournament filter, safe HTML, cross-instance serialized dispatch, retry/counter assertions |
| Web | Add Athlete dialog beside spreadsheet import; friends/club/direct modes; note/presence/fee snapshot; player consent/claim UI |
| Flutter | Optional player consent and response model/client compatibility; no organizer UI unless existing consumer proves one exists |
| Excel/wildcard | unchanged |

## Negative cases

| Case | Required behavior |
|---|---|
| non-manager/unverified caller | 403; no candidate or write |
| friend pending/rejected/soft-deleted at write time | reject; no participant/roster row |
| club member removed or tournament not associated with club | reject |
| user already on active roster | conflict; no duplicate |
| guest direct entry without email | succeeds with one-time claim credential; no synthetic account/email |
| unverified/missing email account match | create guest, never link; claim requires verified account |
| expired/reused/invalid claim token or existing active roster | reject atomically; token cannot be replayed |
| empty roster/guest side, unranked tournament, missing/late consent | no ELO write or history |
| reminder row removed or tournament ended | no email/counter increment |
| mail failure | retry remains eligible; delivered-send counter unchanged |

## Quyết định và điều kiện

1. Separate endpoint and UI from Excel and wildcard.
2. Candidate GET is paginated and reveals only display name/avatar/source; commit rechecks relations.
3. A participant may include account-backed roster rows and guest rows. Any unclaimed guest row keeps ELO gate closed; claim migrates it into `tournament_rosters` with consent NULL.
4. Organizer-added rosters start with NULL consent; player may later opt in; participation/payment/presence are not blocked.
5. Keep existing 24h/72h reminder delay configuration unchanged; do not add intervals. Preserve the existing three-send cap and count only successful delivery.
6. Do not add organizer consent status, manual resend button, gender filter, or legal-compliance assertion.
7. Compliance owner review and strict validator are required before PR/release; neither is currently evidenced.

# Data Entity — organizer-add-athlete-consent-20261005

## Thay đổi

| Entity | Change | Writer |
|---|---|---|
| `tournament_participants` | Add nullable `organizer_note varchar(280)`; existing `entry_fee_at_registration` and `is_present` unchanged | Add-athlete transaction |
| `tournament_guest_rosters` (new) | Guest player identity/contact, participant/role, claim token hash, expiry/claimed timestamp; FK to participant | Direct add; claim transaction consumes row |
| `tournament_rosters` | Existing required `user_id`, role, and consent timestamp retained; on guest claim insert account row with `rankingConsentAt=NULL` | Player claim / existing self consent |

## Guest table minimum fields

`id`, `participant_id`, `display_name`, `role`, nullable `contact_email`, nullable `contact_phone`, unique nullable `claim_token_hash`, nullable `claim_expires_at`, `created_at`. Contact data and token hash are nulled/deleted on successful claim according to retention review. Raw token is never stored.

## Read/write rules

- Direct `email` is optional. A matching account is used only when its email is verified; otherwise persist a guest, not a user/account link.
- The organizer note is trimmed, max 280 characters; it is not kept in `customResponses`.
- `entryFeeAtRegistration` is resolved from the division/tournament inside the transaction and never overwritten by fee edits.
- `isPresent` starts false and remains independent of team status and consent.
- Guest rows count as unconsented roster slots in ELO gates. Claim replaces a guest row with a real `tournament_rosters` row with no consent timestamp.
- No schema change to friendship or community tables.

## Invariants

- Unique active account roster per tournament/division follows existing capacity/duplicate policy.
- Claim credential is random, single-use, expiry-bounded, and only its hash is persisted.
- Guest or empty participant side blocks ELO; claim/consent never retroactively scores completed matches.
- Migration has not been applied to a real database.

## Vấn đề

Tab đăng ký của organizer hiện có nhập danh sách từ biểu mẫu/bảng tính, nhưng chưa có luồng riêng để thêm bạn bè, thành viên CLB hoặc ghi danh trực tiếp. Trường ELO consent hiện bắt buộc ở một số form đăng ký Web/Flutter, dù nghiệp vụ yêu cầu người chơi vẫn được tham gia khi từ chối hoặc chưa xác nhận. Luồng guest chưa có cơ chế claim an toàn.

Yêu cầu là bổ sung luồng **Thêm VĐV** độc lập với Excel và **Gán suất đặc cách**, đồng thời giữ API/field cũ tương thích. Mỗi roster user tự xác nhận ELO; consent không cản trở tham gia và không hồi tố. Organizer không được thay mặt người chơi xác nhận.

## Bất biến

| # | Quy tắc |
|---|---|
| R1 | Candidate bạn bè chỉ khi quan hệ `ACCEPTED` và `deletedAt IS NULL`; ghi roster phải kiểm tra lại. |
| R2 | Candidate CLB phải đang `JOINED` trong CLB gắn với giải; ghi roster phải kiểm tra lại. |
| R3 | Không trả candidate đã nằm trong roster đang hoạt động của giải/nội dung. |
| R4 | Email optional; chỉ gắn tài khoản có `isEmailVerified=true`; guest cần claim token dùng một lần, lưu hash và chỉ claim bởi user đã xác minh. |
| R5 | Consent theo từng `tournament_rosters.userId`, một chiều, tự xác nhận; trận chỉ tính nếu hoàn tất sau consent của mọi roster user hai bên. Roster rỗng/guest chưa claim fail-closed. |
| R6 | Fee snapshot lấy server-side từ `entryFeeAtRegistration`; không đọc fee hiện tại để hiển thị giao dịch cũ. Chỉ hiện payment khi snapshot `> 0`. |
| R7 | Note ngắn; hiển thị cuối dòng. `isPresent` độc lập với trạng thái thi đấu và ELO. Không lọc giới tính. |
| R8 | Scheduler bỏ roster đã remove và giải `COMPLETED`/`CANCELLED`; escape HTML; không gửi trùng đồng thời giữa instances; lỗi gửi không tăng counter. |
| R9 | Timestamps trả về ISO-8601 UTC. Không chạy migration trên DB thật, không push, không tự xác nhận tuân thủ pháp lý. |

## Bằng chứng trạng thái hiện tại

- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/tournaments.controller.ts:1491-1543`: đã có route preview/commit Excel; route mới không thay thế các route này.
- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/repositories/tournament-import.repository.ts:249-397`: strict roster import yêu cầu email và resolve account IDs; `:399-567` là legacy import riêng.
- `backend/src/database/schema/tournaments.schema.ts:241-279`: roster `userId` bắt buộc; consent timestamp và reminder counters đã có.
- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/repositories/tournament-participant.repository.ts:107-177`: consent hiện chỉ ghi roster row của chính người chơi và idempotent.
- `web/src/app/(public)/tournaments/[id]/components/RegisterModal.tsx:36-47` và `DoublesRegistrationFlow.tsx:417-425`: Web chặn đăng ký nếu chưa consent.
- `app/lib/features/register/screens/tournament_register_screen.dart:537-555`: Flutter chặn đăng ký nếu chưa consent; `football_team_register_screen.dart:251-262` gửi `rankingConsent: true`.
- `backend/src/modules/tournaments/services/ranking-consent.service.ts:17-20,42-109`: giới hạn hiện tại 3 notification tổng, delay hiện hữu 24h/72h; không đổi lịch.
- `backend/src/modules/rankings/rankings.service.ts:1787-1834,2034-2073`: replay đã kiểm consent theo từng phía nhưng query không giới hạn `isRanked`.
- `backend/src/modules/rankings/rankings.service.ts:264-306`: `updateMatchElo` kiểm match completed/ranked nhưng chưa kiểm consent.
- `backend/src/database/schema/tournaments.schema.ts:208-217`: `isPresent` và `entryFeeAtRegistration` đã có; participant schema không có organizer note.

## Ngoài phạm vi

- Không thay Excel, không gọi hoặc thay luồng wildcard/cấp suất đặc cách.
- Không tự đặt reminder schedule mới, không thêm organizer consent status/resend UI.
- Không thay luật tính ELO chung; `insertAdminEloHistory` tiếp tục ngoài gate giải đấu.
- Không thực thi migration/DB production, không tạo chứng nhận compliance.
"}

| Components | Có | tournaments, rankings, scheduler/mail, Web RegistrationTab |
| Dynamic flow | Có | candidate → add/guest → claim/self-consent → ELO |
| Deployment | Có | DB migration; không chạy trên DB thật |
| Data flow/trust boundary | Có | email, friendship/club relations, one-time claim credential |

## 4. Lựa chọn

| Lựa chọn | Lợi ích | Chi phí/rủi ro | Quyết định |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mở rộng import Excel | ít endpoint | nhập nhằng email, preview, nguồn và wildcard | loại |
| Tạo candidate/add route riêng | recheck quyền/quan hệ, không phá import | API/schema/UI mới | chọn |
| Account giả cho guest | dùng roster hiện có | tạo danh tính đăng nhập giả, ảnh hưởng ELO/social | loại |
| Bảng guest riêng + one-time claim | không link email chưa xác minh; roster trống fail-closed | migration và claim flow | chọn |

## 5. Thiết kế chọn

- **Boundary:** Tournament module sở hữu candidates/add/claim/note; player consent qua self-service route; RankingsService sở hữu gate ELO.
- **Dependency:** controller → service → repository; notifications và mail sau commit; không gọi wildcard.
- **Data/API:** thêm `organizer_note` (tối đa 280 ký tự), `tournament_guest_rosters` và API mới; response chỉ thêm field optional.
- **Security/privacy:** manager+Verified; accepted friendship/non-deleted và club `JOINED` được recheck trong transaction; claim token hash+single-use; candidate không trả email.
- **Reliability:** lock capacity dùng pattern hiện có; notification fail không rollback participant; reminder row lock/claim ngăn gửi đồng thời.
- **Performance:** phân trang candidates; batch-load avatar/profile; không N+1; chỉ query participant roster theo giải/nội dung.
- **Cost:** một migration và ít mail tăng thêm; không thêm dependency.

## 6. Fitness checks

| ID | Quy tắc | Kiểm tra | Điều kiện pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| ARCH-001 | Excel/wildcard contracts không đổi | regression tests + diff | existing tests pass; route untouched |
| ARCH-002 | relation and owner rechecked on write | service/repository tests | stale friendship/membership rejects |
| ARCH-003 | ELO fails closed | enqueue/apply/replay/manual tests | no empty roster, guest, unranked, late consent scored |
| ARCH-004 | no secrets in output/logs | review + search diff | raw token never logged or stored |
| ARCH-005 | reminder retry/dedupe | concurrent service spec | one simultaneous send; failed send does not increment |

## 7. Delivery/recovery

- Backend tests first; migration SQL reviewed, not applied to real DB; Web UI then Flutter compatibility.
- Additive response fields; old readers ignore them. New frontend tolerates missing optional values.
- Rollback code and migration only if no guest/note data has been written; after data creation migration rollback requires export/retention decision.
- No feature flag exists; do not invent one in this change.
- Observability: reuse scheduler log and existing notification outcomes; do not log email, token, phone or note.

## 8. Waivers

None. Validator absence is not a waiver.

## 9. Review outcome

- **Decision:** `accepted-with-conditions` as an implementation design, not an external approval.
- **Conditions:** compliance owner review and strict workflow validation before release/PR; review user-facing claim retention and consent email.
- **Open risks:** migration not run against staging; mail provider has no confirmed idempotency-key contract; durable exactly-once delivery cannot be claimed.
- **Approval:** no compliance-owner approval recorded.

## 10. Convergence

Pending implementation and test evidence. Do not mark accepted/released until all gates are evidenced.
"}

Decision: **GO_WITH_CONDITIONS**.

## Source of truth

- Tournament/manager ownership: `TournamentAccessService.isManager`, same permission boundary as import.
- Friendship eligibility: `friendships.status='ACCEPTED' AND deletedAt IS NULL`; current `FriendshipsRepository.listActiveForUser` is insufficient by itself (`:77-91`).
- Club eligibility: tournament `communityId` and `community_members.status='JOINED'`.
- Fee: `TournamentPaymentRepository.resolveDivisionEntryFee`; save resulting `entryFeeAtRegistration` on creation. Snapshot field already exists.
- Presence: `tournament_participants.isPresent`, independent.
- Consent: `tournament_rosters.rankingConsentAt`, timestamp written only by that player's own session; no organizer state/control.
- ELO: enqueue, apply, replay and direct `updateMatchElo` must all verify ranked setting and every roster user consented before `completedAt`; `insertAdminEloHistory` excluded.

## Phạm vi ảnh hưởng

| Khu vực | Thay đổi |
|---|---|
| Backend tournaments | New candidate/add/direct/claim/consent routes; note and guest repository/DTOs; manager and source eligibility checks |
| Backend schema | `organizer_note` and `tournament_guest_rosters`; migration generated/reviewed, not applied to real DB |
| Backend rankings | Gate direct update and replay against `isRanked`; ensure enqueue uses completion timestamp; preserve admin history |
| Backend scheduler | active roster/tournament filter, safe HTML, cross-instance serialized dispatch, retry/counter assertions |
| Web | Add Athlete dialog beside spreadsheet import; friends/club/direct modes; note/presence/fee snapshot; player consent/claim UI |
| Flutter | Optional player consent and response model/client compatibility; no organizer UI unless existing consumer proves one exists |
| Excel/wildcard | unchanged |

## Negative cases

| Case | Required behavior |
|---|---|
| non-manager/unverified caller | 403; no candidate or write |
| friend pending/rejected/soft-deleted at write time | reject; no participant/roster row |
| club member removed or tournament not associated with club | reject |
| user already on active roster | conflict; no duplicate |
| guest direct entry without email | succeeds with one-time claim credential; no synthetic account/email |
| unverified/missing email account match | create guest, never link; claim requires verified account |
| expired/reused/invalid claim token or existing active roster | reject atomically; token cannot be replayed |
| empty roster/guest side, unranked tournament, missing/late consent | no ELO write or history |
| reminder row removed or tournament ended | no email/counter increment |
| mail failure | retry remains eligible; delivered-send counter unchanged |

## Quyết định và điều kiện

1. Separate endpoint and UI from Excel and wildcard.
2. Candidate GET is paginated and reveals only display name/avatar/source; commit rechecks relations.
3. A participant may include account-backed roster rows and guest rows. Any unclaimed guest row keeps ELO gate closed; claim migrates it into `tournament_rosters` with consent NULL.
4. Organizer-added rosters start with NULL consent; player may later opt in; participation/payment/presence are not blocked.
5. Keep existing 24h/72h reminder delay configuration unchanged; do not add intervals. Preserve the existing three-send cap and count only successful delivery.
6. Do not add organizer consent status, manual resend button, gender filter, or legal-compliance assertion.
7. Compliance owner review and strict validator are required before PR/release; neither is currently evidenced.

| Entity | Change | Writer |
|---|---|---|
| `tournament_participants` | Add nullable `organizer_note varchar(280)`; existing `entry_fee_at_registration` and `is_present` unchanged | Add-athlete transaction |

| `tournament_rosters` | Existing required `user_id`, role, and consent timestamp retained; on guest claim insert account row with `rankingConsentAt=NULL` | Player claim / existing self consent |

## Guest table minimum fields

`id`, `participant_id`, `display_name`, `role`, nullable `contact_email`, nullable `contact_phone`, unique nullable `claim_token_hash`, nullable `claim_expires_at`, `created_at`. Contact data and token hash are nulled/deleted on successful claim according to retention review. Raw token is never stored.

## Read/write rules

- Direct `email` is optional. A matching account is used only when its email is verified; otherwise persist a guest, not a user/account link.
- The organizer note is trimmed, max 280 characters; it is not kept in `customResponses`.
- `entryFeeAtRegistration` is resolved from the division/tournament inside the transaction and never overwritten by fee edits.
- `isPresent` starts false and remains independent of team status and consent.
- Guest rows count as unconsented roster slots in ELO gates. Claim replaces a guest row with a real `tournament_rosters` row with no consent timestamp.
- No schema change to friendship or community tables.

## Invariants

- Unique active account roster per tournament/division follows existing capacity/duplicate policy.
- Claim credential is random, single-use, expiry-bounded, and only its hash is persisted.
- Guest or empty participant side blocks ELO; claim/consent never retroactively scores completed matches.
- Migration has not been applied to a real database.
